description: List the CURRENT edition year/adoption date and ARCHIVED edition PDF links for CACI (civil) and/or CALCRIM (criminal) jury instructions. Use when a caller needs a past year's edition (e.g. for a trial that occurred under an older version) or just wants to confirm which edition caci_lookup/calcrim_lookup text comes from. Archived editions are LINKED, not text-extracted — only the current edition's instruction text is available via caci_lookup/calcrim_lookup. Keyless.
